description: An object that has changed outside Terraform when it's next refreshed, among others that haven't. A plan without refreshing sees nothing; a refresh-only plan reports the change and applying it updates the state and nothing else; a normal plan then proposes to put the object back, which is applied. The state before refreshing and the state after it differ here, so the two snapshots in the plan file do too.

steps.name: create
expect: Plan: 6 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy

steps.name: refresh-only
expect: Objects have changed outside of Terraform

steps.name: put-back
expect: Plan: 0 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy

steps.name: drifts-again
expect: Plan: 0 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy
